findings.finding: B184NoLM shows severe medium-group item sensitivity: one 20s capped output yields 213 ASR insertions and 222 total errors for 10 reference words. Keep in official metrics/CI; ASR repetition candidate, not human-verified acoustic repetition.
Primary A→BNoLM changes both ordinary training and LM prompting. It is a complete-system comparison; isolated training claims require A→B and matched-strategy ANoLM→BNoLM / ASplit→BSplit.

CI resamples normalized text clusters within length strata, retaining paired generation seeds; it does not cover training-run population variance or ASR uncertainty. Final has 60 distinct paragraph group IDs for 60 texts, 30 from each of two works; source-level generalization remains unmeasured.
Two primary outcomes share correlated data. Report their prespecified status and unadjusted intervals; secondary contrasts and subgroup analyses are exploratory. No final-set reselection.

Cap items remain scored and in 120-item failure denominators. Complete is pipeline terminal status, not guaranteed content completeness; missing-as-deletions sensitivity equals scored metrics because there are no missing outputs.
B and B184NoLM each have one 31.68s output for holmes-p01214-s04-n2 seed17 crossing the Whisper 30s window; other seven cells have zero. This is an ASR-path limitation, not automatic invalidity.

caveats: Latest event per raw key only. Totals are recorded item timing sums, not whole-run wall-clock or total historical retry cost; model loading and earlier failed attempts may be absent.
ASR-only resume can retain an earlier generation_seconds but replace attempt_seconds. Do not add generation, ASR, and attempt times together or infer overhead by subtraction.

RTF uses matched rows with known nonnegative numerator and positive recorded audio duration; unknown fields stay unknown. Audio duration is the recorded delivered waveform duration including inserted pauses, not speech-only duration; this report does not reread WAVs.

process_peak_rss_bytes is the process cumulative high-water RSS, not per-item incremental memory. The maximum across latest records may span resumed processes; process identity and continuous whole-run peak are not established.
MPS current/driver maxima are observed post-attempt samples, not continuous allocator or system peaks. Host-wide usage, swap, and other processes are not measured here.
Audio >30 seconds flags the configured Whisper chunk window boundary, not an ASR failure or a quality judgment. Completed outputs can still terminate at a generation cap.
